definitions.def: an animal that hunts and eats other animals
an amount that is more than what is needed
a person from whom one is descended
doing something well without wasting time or energy
the state of having a great deal of money or wealth

grammar_choice.en_template: For most animals the struggle {{1:to survive/surviving}} {{2:takes/take}} up all their time.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 대부분의 동물에게 생존을 위한 투쟁은 그들의 모든 시간을 차지한다.
explain: struggle를 수식하는 형용사적 to부정사 — to survive.

grammar_choice.en_template: Finding food and drink, keeping warm and clean, avoiding predators, migrating and {{1:reproducing/reproduce}} {{2:use/uses}} up all their energies.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 먹이와 마실 것을 찾고, 따뜻하고 깨끗하게 지내고, 포식자를 피하고, 이주하고 번식하는 일이 그들의 모든 에너지를 써 버린다.

grammar_choice.en_template: If they do have any time to spare, they spend {{1:it/them}} {{2:resting/to rest}} or sleeping.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 만약 그들에게 여분의 시간이 조금이라도 있다면, 그들은 그것을 쉬거나 자는 데 쓴다.

grammar_choice.en_template: Only very young animals, under the protection of their parents, {{1:have/has}} enough surplus energy {{2:to engage/engaging}} in lively bouts of play.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 오직 부모의 보호를 받는 아주 어린 동물들만이 활기찬 놀이에 빠질 만큼 충분한 여분의 에너지를 가진다.
explain: 주어 핵 = young animals(복수) → have. (중간 of their parents에 동사를 일치시키지 않도록 주의.)
enough + 명사 + to V — to engage.

grammar_choice.en_template: This {{1:was/were}} also true {{2:for/to}} our early ancestors.
The constant search for food {{1:would have put/would have been put}} heavy demands {{2:upon/of}} them.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 끊임없는 먹이 탐색이 그들에게 무거운 부담을 주었을 것이다.
explain: 주어가 demands를 '지우는' 능동 — would have put.

grammar_choice.en_template: But as they slowly {{1:evolved/evolving}} into more and more efficient hunters, the situation {{2:changed/changing}}.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그러나 그들이 점점 더 효율적인 사냥꾼으로 천천히 진화하면서, 상황이 바뀌었다.

grammar_choice.en_template: The secret of their success {{1:was/were}} the development of {{2:much/very}} greater intelligence.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그들의 성공 비결은 훨씬 더 뛰어난 지능의 발달이었다.

grammar_choice.en_template: They used brain not brawn {{1:to kill/killing}} {{2:their/them}} prey.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그들은 먹이를 잡기 위해 힘이 아니라 머리를 썼다.
explain: 목적('~하기 위해')의 부사적 to부정사 — to kill.

grammar_choice.en_template: At the end of the long hunting era, before they turned to farming, they {{1:were/was}} already {{2:enjoying/enjoyed}} some degree of affluence.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 긴 사냥 시대의 끝 무렵, 농경으로 전환하기 전에, 그들은 이미 어느 정도의 풍요를 누리고 있었다.

grammar_choice.en_template: In certain regions, at particular times of year, the prey was sufficiently plentiful and their hunting techniques sufficiently advanced {{1:for/of}} them {{2:to experience/experiencing}} a remarkable degree of prosperity.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 특정 지역에서, 한 해의 특정 시기에, 먹이가 충분히 풍부하고 그들의 사냥 기술이 충분히 발달하여 그들은 놀라운 정도의 번영을 경험할 수 있었다.
explain: sufficiently ~ for A to V 구문 — to experience.
have time on one's hands: 시간이 남아돌다(고정 전치사 on).

jumble.answer: For most animals the struggle to survive takes up all their time.
Finding food and drink, keeping warm and clean, avoiding predators, migrating and reproducing use up all their energies.
If they do have any time to spare, they spend it resting or sleeping.
Only very young animals, under the protection of their parents, have enough surplus energy to engage in lively bouts of play.
This was also true for our early ancestors.
The constant search for food would have put heavy demands upon them.
But as they slowly evolved into more and more efficient hunters, the situation changed.
The secret of their success was the development of much greater intelligence.
They used brain not brawn to kill their prey.
At the end of the long hunting era, before they turned to farming, they were already enjoying some degree of affluence.
In certain regions, at particular times of year, the prey was sufficiently plentiful and their hunting techniques sufficiently advanced for them to experience a remarkable degree of prosperity.
They had time on their hands.
